column1: # OWASP ZAP Scan Rules
# Format: rule_id<TAB>alert_level<TAB>reason
# alert_level: IGNORE, WARN, FAIL
# Tuned for a FastAPI JSON API scanned directly (no nginx) in CI.
# The zap jobs fail on Medium+ findings by default; the FAIL lines below
# pin the real vulnerability classes so that contract stays explicit.
# --- False positives / accepted risks for this stack -----------------------
# Informational: Suspicious comments in static assets (app serves no static assets)

column3: Informational: Suspicious comments in static assets

column1: # Informational: Timestamp disclosure — Date/Server headers are standard; ISO
# timestamps in JSON payloads are application data, not information leakage

column3: Informational: Timestamp disclosure in headers

column1: # Informational: Incomplete or no cache-control header set — JSON API responses;
# per-endpoint caching policy is an application design choice, not a vuln

column3: Informational: Incomplete or no cache-control header set

column1: # Informational: Base64 Disclosure — the API legitimately transports
# base64-encoded tokens and blob identifiers in JSON responses

column3: Informational: Base64 Disclosure in API responses

column1: # Informational: Hash Disclosure — the API legitimately returns SHA-256 hashes

column3: Informational: Hash Disclosure in API responses

column3: HTTP-only target expected in CI (TLS at nginx in deploys); WARN level would fail the gate
